text:
marie_fin: Heads up 1: our April marketplace bill shows a "Marketplace entitlement reclassification" credit applied to reseller RidgePeak (reseller_id RP-9001). Credit amount: -$2,450. I don't recognize the entitlement IDs referenced. Can someone confirm source?

sam_ops: which invoice? pls paste the billing line or CSV snippet.

diego_rev: Invoice INV-2026-0501 from AWS consolidated bill. Extracted lines:```
invoice_id,sku,description,units,unit_price,total
INV-2026-0501,MW-RIDGE-01,Redwood Inference - gen tokens,2500000,0.08,200000.00
INV-2026-0501,MW-RIDGE-01,Marketplace entitlement reclassification credit,-1,0.00,-2450.00
```

anna_sales: RidgePeak had a mid-month seat adjustment via our reseller portal that should not have triggered a reclass. Their seat count stayed in band C (50+). We gave them a one-off promotional uplift on Mar 20 which is properly in our records; could AWS have reconciled promotional lines differently?

marie_fin: need to know whether AWS changed the entitlement tagging (e.g., consolidated vs direct purchase) because that affects revenue recognition and our handling of commission to RidgePeak.

sam_ops: opening AWS case now. I'll include the entitlement IDs from the report and our reseller mapping. CASE-60327801 created. AWS ETA 48 hours.

aws-billing-bot: Support case created: CASE-60327801. Status: open.

diego_rev: tagging internal ticket REV-5029 and saving raw usage export for audit. If AWS reclassed purchases from "reseller" to "end-customer-direct", we could owe a reclaim of reseller commissions.

marie_fin: do not adjust revenue on our books until we get AWS confirmation. Flag for month-end review if unresolved. Also, prepare a preliminary estimate of commission exposure: RidgePeak commission rate is 12% of net. At $2,450 credit, exposure ~ $294.

anna_sales: I'll hold external comms with RidgePeak until we know if AWS will reverse. We might need legal if AWS refuses to clarify.

sam_ops: AWS replied preliminary: "Adjustment due to entitlement deduplication during partner billing consolidation. We are running entitlement-level audit and will provide manifests." Asked for corrected invoice or explanation.

aws-billing-bot: CASE-60327801 updated: AWS response received.

marie_fin: good. once we have manifests forward to accounting and revops. Also drop a note in the partner record (RP-9001) with temporary flag "billing_under_review".

diego_rev: done 1 wrote REV-5029 entry and attached CSVs.

sam_ops: AWS pushed manifest file and says corrected invoice will be issued if reclassification is their error. Est timeline 3 business days.

marie_fin: ok. if AWS issues corrected invoice, we'll reverse the credit and normal settlement proceeds. If not, we'll schedule a one-off chargeback to RidgePeak for the amount plus commission clawback and route through partner ops.

anna_sales: noted. will prepare a short partner note template in case we need to request payment.

marie_fin: thanks all. keeping this thread as the canonical audit trail. Please upload any new docs to REV-5029.

aws-billing-bot: CASE-60327801 closed: corrected invoice to be issued.

sam_ops: AWS closed with confirmation they'll issue INV-2026-0501-REV1 reversing the -$2,450 credit. I'll post the new invoice when available.

marie_fin: closing internal action: hold revenue adjustments until REV1. If we see the corrected invoice, we will reverse the temporary variance in April close. Thanks everyone.
